verdict.rationale: Trello's own marketing states it can "Automate tasks and workflows" (trello-docs-3), which is a first-party automation claim. However, nothing in the pack describes defining rules, event triggers, or resulting actions. Power-Up buttons and REST webhooks are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documentation of a rule builder with event-based triggers and actions, examples of supported trigger events and actions, details on automation limits or plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.
